culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Maika Kayaki. She reveals that kills the Usui to avenge her brother Reisuke as he was part of the crime gang group that commits the bank transfer scam operations. Reisuke is assigned to go to the bank and receive the money. Eventually, the Police officers chase Reisuke down during their stakeout where he slips and falls from the stairs that he died.
